import html # Example template; in real usage this would be defined elsewhere. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def show_blog_post(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Return a sanitized and formatted blog post ready for safe display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The heading of the blog post. text : str The main body content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted HTML of the post. """ if not isinstance(headline, str) or not isinstance(text, str): raise TypeError("headline and text must be strings") # Escape HTML to prevent XSS attacks safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Format using the predefined template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_text) return formatted_post
